execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."Address" (
  "addressLine1" text NOT NULL,
  "addressLine2" text,
  "city" text NOT NULL,
  "country" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "postalCode" text NOT NULL,
  "state" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Cart" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CartItem" (
  "cartId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "variantId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Category" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Order" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "paymentMethod" text DEFAULT 'CASH_ON_DELIVERY' NOT NULL,
  "paymentStatus" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "shippingAddressLine1" text NOT NULL,
  "shippingAddressLine2" text,
  "shippingAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "shippingCity" text NOT NULL,
  "shippingCountry" text NOT NULL,
  "shippingName" text NOT NULL,
  "shippingPhone" text NOT NULL,
  "shippingPostalCode" text NOT NULL,
  "shippingState" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "total" numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Order_paymentMethod_check_87d7d887" CHECK ("paymentMethod" IN ('CASH_ON_DELIVERY')),
  CONSTRAINT "Order_paymentStatus_check_aad465af" CHECK ("paymentStatus" IN ('PENDING', 'PAID')),
  CONSTRAINT "Order_status_check_90625984" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'PROCESSING', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."OrderItem" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "orderId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "productName" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "totalPrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  "variantId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "variantName" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Product" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "categoryId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ProductImage" (
  "altText" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ProductVariant" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "sku" text NOT NULL,
  "stockStatus" text DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE' NOT NULL,
  "unit" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "value" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ProductVariant_stockStatus_check_ac1a5ec5" CHECK ("stockStatus" IN ('AVAILABLE', 'LOW_STOCK', 'OUT_OF_STOCK')),
  CONSTRAINT "ProductVariant_unit_check_e45c3311" CHECK ("unit" IN ('ML', 'L', 'G', 'KG'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'CUSTOMER' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "User_role_check_3cc42c46" CHECK ("role" IN ('CUSTOMER', 'ADMIN'))
)
